name: Atlantic hurricanes
value: No Atlantic storms; none expected in 7 days
summary: NHC reports no Atlantic tropical cyclone on 16 Nov and expects none to form in the next seven days
state: The National Hurricane Center's Atlantic outlook issued at 12:00 UTC on 16 Nov reported no active storm and said tropical cyclone formation was not expected in the North Atlantic, Caribbean or Gulf during the next seven days (NHC). The Atlantic season formally ends on 30 Nov. With no storm threatening land, the level stays Normal.
for_you: No Atlantic, Caribbean or Gulf storm is active or expected in the next week. Anyone travelling to the region before the season ends on 30 Nov can follow the National Hurricane Center and FCDO travel advice.
rubric_hit: No hurricane active and none forecast to form within 7 days (NHC, 16 Nov) = Normal

sources.title: NHC Graphical Tropical Weather Outlooks (Atlantic, 16 Nov 2026)

why: Atlantic hurricanes hit the US Gulf coast, Caribbean and Central America — and refinery and insurance markets with them.
drivers: Sea-surface temperatures, ENSO, wind shear, season timing (Jun–Nov peak Aug–Oct).
